World Steel Association (worldsteel) (2021). Life cycle inventory (LCI) study: 2021 data release. Eighth global LCI study for steel products. worldsteel, Brussels.

background: Cradle-to-gate life cycle inventory/impact results per kg of steel PRODUCT (sections, hot rolled coil, hot-dip galvanized), aggregated over sites and routes with upstream and system-expansion credits; primary energy demand rather than final energy; no gate-to-gate energy, cost, capacity or emissions for individual process technologies. Not usable at archetype level. What it has: Table 6 (p.19): cradle-to-gate PED 21.8 / 25.2 / 28.8 MJ/kg and GWP 1.92 / 2.30 / 2.59 kg CO2e/kg for sections / hot rolled coil / HDG (with recycling credit 17.6/14.8/18.1 MJ and 1.45/1.14/1.40 kg); Table 5 steel scrap LCI value 15.4 MJ and 1.66 kg CO2e per kg scrap; Table 4 slag recovery (BF 98%, BOF 97%, EAF 87%) and uses; net scrap input 0.56 t/t sections, 0.15 t/t HRC, 0.13 t/t HDG; 85% end-of-life recycling rate assumed; grid-mix appendix. Locators are printed page numbers.
